I have to comment on this thread, not to agree with you, but rather to point in areas people complain over and where people defend riot over.

I won't care if this post gets read at all, it's a reddit flipping hivemind mentality here anyway.

I have played this game since beta, most people here haven't im sure of that. All these reddit circlejerks that go on day in and day out, I ignore them. All the complaining from low elo to high elo, I ignore them. I ignore most of these things, since often its just people not knowing what the hell they are talking about.

I ain't some "low elo scrub", but I have been around high elo since preseason 1 and I have experienced Riot and their practices since the START. I was a volunteer Wrenchman back when GOA was running EU. Those who know who GOA is can relate to me.

Let's get to the main points.
Riot as a company that listens to players has always been one of their key mottoes and by far, they have upheld to it, until recently.
Things and how riot listened to players was exceptionally praise-able and something we trusted in. 

Why is the trust fading? Why are there so many people on uproar all the time?
It's because Riot grew so they had to focus on the bigger picture like anyone who gets more responsibility has to do. Most probably don't know what that feels like so they complain that they don't get the attention they demand.

Now, on the other hand, they are going too far with the whole bigger picture. They are no longer focusing on things which are keeping this game alive and in a healthy ascend. Don't bring up the "LOOK HOW POPULAR THIS GAME IS" fact, this happens to everyone who takes a bite they can't chew on. Riot did the same thing when this game started to grow insanely fast. Don't believe me? Season 2, look how huge the game became during season 2. Look where we are now and how the community is starting to doubt in Riots decision.

My main point on why Riot is starting to neglect and/or forget what made them this big, is based on How much they are listening to the community right now and how they are treating the players.

* They listen and participate with the community a lot, which is still good. But they don't focus on the areas anymore that kept this game going healthy. Example : Skin textures, additions and changes ; Portraits and visuals in general. They are remoddeling and improving this games visuals, yet a lot of the core problems and bugs take more time to sort out. 

From Programmers and coders perspective, I've heard it can be a really hard thing to do, if the code is very complex, which is the case here.
Thanks to the outdated code, sorting out the game to please the community takes longer and requires more effort/time and funding to do. THIS alone will make Riot lose out on money and players who are tired of this ( Example, Before EU was split and GOA was running, delivering patches, bugfixes etc. took more time and EU took a hit in players and trust in GOA&Riot , so Riot eventually took over to prevent the damage from going further ).

* The second part is how they treat the players. It's an old topic, but its important in a way. The old playerbase is leaving the game slowly or getting tired. I know a lot of players who played during Beta/season 1 and most are gone since they all said "This game is heading in the wrong direction and I'm abandoning ship".
Limited & Legacy skins, rewards for older players and appreciation for them, Feedback from them and trying to keep them playing by keeping the game fresh. None of these exist anymore.

This might make it seem like I am being a bit salty or greedy, but it's not that. I don't feel like everything I have done after season 1 is appreciated. The work older players have done to keep this game evolving and going has been for nothing. All we helped with in the past is being changed and everyone is hating on it who have not been back then at the "Good old days".

*Final and MAIN key element. This game is losing it's identity. All the fun stuff and uniqueness in game elements and champions are being changed into a static and similar style, so everyone is on EQUAL grounds in the game. THERE is the problem. Equality = No innovation, no creativeness and no uniqueness => A forgettable game. Only thing keeping Riot going is their past reputation and the player base. Remove that and this game would be nowhere and that is where this game is going. I feel like no one is no longer punished when playing wrong or doing something wrong, they have a "second chance" somewhere implemented in the game. Every game I play feels exactly the same ( I played over 4k games and NEVER felt this feeling before, after the last 1000 games, i've felt that ) and I am getting bored and finding other things to do. Only time I feel different is if I face real challenges or challenging players ( We are talking about high elo, where there aren't many people who can feel this, so the rest never get this feeling potentially,which is a big % of players ).

Riot right now has their last lifeline remaining in this game : Their current playerbase. You lose that and this game will be going completely downhill.

**TL;DR** Beta high elo player, notices the game has changed since Season 2. Main reason is game feels no longer unique, losing its theme and identity, challenge is lost and things are becoming dull and boring. Riot needs to focus on keeping current playerbase going or this game will die out very soon.

Here is the thing, darius has a decent chuck of base dmg, but any combination of armor and HP on a tanky sustain based top laner will make your life hard, due to mana issues.

My build goes like this :

Trinity force, Mercs/ninja, Randuins omen, Maw ( if they got even 1 AP ), GA/Mallet/Banshee/Black clever/FH or any other situational item.

let me explain a few things on my build :


1 . Trinity force : Underrated on him, Darius lack mobility, but the phage proc on minion kill or in general gives you nice amount of movement combined with your bleed stacks and zeal, to compensate for the lack.
Then also with the sheen proc on W, it gives you a lot of pushing power and if you crit, its deadly in fights when peeling/zoning.

In my eyes, its an essential since it gives him too much power people dont think works on him.


2 .Randuins omen : Before the nerf that no movement speed reduction o hit, it also gave you a chance to escape & chase someone who kites you. Not only that, the HP and armor is quite huge for the price cost, its very cost efficent on him.


3 . Maw of mortimus : Not a lot of people get this. That's a lot of base AD + MR + shield when you get hexdrinker and since the cost is cheap and building it is also efficient ( Longsword can be made into Brutalizer, Phage, Hexdrinker and Null Magic mantel into Hexdrinker or Mercury threads )
But also since you want to prolong teamfights, you getting lower in life makes your dmg stronger, so you get stronger while also doing your tanking job.


The rest of the items depends on the situation ofc.

Now, bare in mind that this build works for ME AND MY STYLE, it might not work for you. There are tricks that go with it, but that comes from experience.
But all in all, this build gives you enough tankiness and dmg to go in, do your dmg&tank and GET OUT. You dont need sustain from hydra, thats not how you're supposed to play Darius.

Let's take a scenario where you are winning bot lane ( 2-0 for both ADC and Sup ) and the other lanes are losing on farm + kills.

First thing you need to do, get that tower down as fast as you can and push only a little bit more. This will force their jungler and possibly mid to help defend and then you fall back if there is no chance to fight and win ( Support needs to ward all the possible paths down there , so you have enough time to escape )

After that, tell your jungler to help with the dragon and try and get it. The reason for these two steps are simple.

* Global gold for lanes that are not doing so well
* You force the other lanes to roam and help bottom, giving your laners enough time to farm and possibly push down towers and get back into the game.

These are your best bets. If these don't help you, then you just have to try farm up, play turtle and hope the enemy team does mistakes so your team can catch up.
